node.title: Re: Creating data delimited by ASCII code 1 using perl
node.author: shmem
node.doctext:
ASCII code 1 (binary1),

ASCII code 1:

$\ = "\n"; # output record separator print "\x01"; # hex print "\001"; # octal print "\cA"; # control char print pack "C",1; # byte with the lowest bit set

You can use any of them with [doc://join] and [doc://split].

perl -le'print map{pack c,($-++?1:13)+ord}split//,ESEL'
